outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B consists of phase contrast micrographs, not a plot; individual data points are not applicable.
The bottom bar chart in panel C displays mean ± SEM bars with individual data points (distinct circle/square/triangle markers for each of the 3 replicates) overlaid on each bar.
The bottom bar chart in panel D displays mean ± SD bars with individual data points (dot markers for each of the 3 replicates) overlaid on each bar.
Panel E is a heatmap of Z-scores; heatmaps are exempt from the individual data points requirement.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Both bar chart sets in panel G (pluripotency genes and lineage marker genes) show mean ± SEM bars with individual data points (circle/square/triangle markers for each of the 3 replicates) overlaid.
Panel H consists of immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot; individual data points are not applicable.
